hero.tagline: A new generation law firm delivering best quality legal work — with integrity, passion, and an unwavering commitment to justice.

paragraphs: Litigo Law Chamber is a dynamic law firm based in Uttarakhand, India, constituted by a group of young and passionate lawyers who epitomize the face of the new generation legal practice.
In a short span, the firm has achieved great heights and handles a niche clientele including various corporate houses, financial institutions, co-operative societies and firms across India.
With associates in all major cities of India, the firm believes that having superior infrastructure is quintessential in providing the highest quality service to its clients.

quote.text: Our belief was that hard work and exploring new frontiers would lead us to success.
quote.author: Naman Kamboj

items.title: Civil Matters
items.desc: Recovery suits, stay & injunction, contractual disputes, property matters, arbitration, motor accidents, consumer cases, and drafting of all types of contracts.

items.title: Writs
items.desc: Filing writs under Articles 32, 226 & 227 of the Constitution — Fundamental Rights, civil liberties, and challenging governmental actions before High Courts and Supreme Court.

items.title: Corporate Litigation
items.desc: Petitions before Debt Recovery Tribunals, Appellate Tribunals, High Courts and Supreme Court on behalf of banks, financial institutions, and public organizations.

items.title: Intellectual Property
items.desc: IPR infringement cases, trademark registration, injunction suits, and comprehensive protection of intellectual property assets across various forums.

items.title: Criminal Matters
items.desc: Criminal appeals, writs, FIR quashing, bail matters, crimes against women, cheque dishonour, private complaints for cheating, fraud & breach of trust.

items.title: Alternate Dispute Resolution
items.desc: Arbitration, conciliation and mediation services — providing a refreshing break from prolonged litigation with unparalleled resolution abilities.
